The corpus-level ../renderings.md binds first. This file holds words and formulas used in Atra-ḫasīs and not in the shared file.
Each tablet's translator edits only that tablet's section. Formulas that recur across the tablets (the noise passage, the plague formula, the elders/heralds passage, the speech formulas) are fixed at their first occurrence, in Tablet I, and the later tablets follow them; a later tablet that needs a change should note it in its own section and in project.md, so the three tablets can be aligned.

Columns: Akkadian | Hebrew | rejected alternatives | reason / tag | lines.

Tablet I

I.1 Recurring formulas of the epic (first occurrence in Tablet I; binding for II–III)

I.2 Words of Tablet I

Akkadian Hebrew Rejected Reason / tag Lines
dullu עָמָל עֲבוֹדַת פֶּרֶךְ (Exodus echo), עֲבוֹדָה (would pre-empt לַעֲבֹד, ב:ה, טו) "Toil, forced labour". 2, 4, 6, 20, 38, 42, 150, 177, 236
tupšikku / šupšikku סַל "drudgery" (abstract) Keep the concrete image (the earth-basket of corvée); note the figurative sense once. 2, 3, 34, 36, 66–67, 149, 162, 186, 193, 237
šapšāqu מְצוּקָה Pun with šupšikku (Jacobsen), noted at I 3. 4, 150, 163, 177

našû נָשָׂא [cognate]. īnšu lišši = יִשָּׂא עֵינָיו: the same idiom as וַתִּשָּׂא … אֶת עֵינֶיהָ (לט:ז) [cognate]. 186, 193, 270
abšānu מוֹטָה עֹל (reserved for ullu) "Yoke(-bar)". 184–185, 190–192
ullu עֹל [cognate]. apṭur ullam ↔ וּפָרַקְתָּ עֻלּוֹ (כז:מ) [equivalent]. 239
andurāru דְּרוֹר [cognate] (Klein: Akk. durāru); ↔ וּקְרָאתֶם דְּרוֹר (ויקרא כה:י). 239
guzalû נוֹשֵׂא הַכִּסֵּא "prefect" Literal; Sum. GU.ZA "chair". 9, 41, 49, 126, 138
gallû הַשּׁוֹטֵר הַנּוֹגֵשׂ Uncertain office ("bailiff"); both Hebrew options echo Exodus 5, so the plainer one. 10, 127, 139

karṣī akālu הִלְשִׁין אָכַל קְרָצִים Idiom "eat the pieces of" = slander; cognate idiom in Aramaic אֲכַלוּ קַרְצֵיהוֹן (דניאל ג:ח), noted. 39, 176
kalakku הַחֲפִירָה The excavation where the gods dug. 40, 147–148, 161
lullû קַדְמוֹן אָדָם (collides with awīlu, I 183 has both), אָדָם הַקַּדְמוֹן (Kabbalistic term), יְצוּר (root יצר reserved for eṣēru) The creature before it is named awīlu (cf. Enūma eliš VI 6–7). Proposed for the shared file. 182–183, 190
banû בָּנָה בָּרָא (Gen 1 verb), יָצַר (reserved for eṣēru), עָשָׂה [cognate]; Hebrew uses it of creating the woman (וַיִּבֶן … אֶת הַצֵּלָע, ב:כב) and of "being built" through children (אִבָּנֶה מִמֶּנָּה, טז:ב; ל:ג). Tools in I 337: עָשׂוּ, with a note. 34, 36, 182–183, 189–190, 289, 337–338, 370, 402
eṣēru, uṣurtu צָר, צוּרוֹת יָצַר, יְצָרִים (would import the later sense "inclination" of יֵצֶר) Akk. eṣēru "draw, design" is the cognate of יצר (Klein, BDB): ↔ וַיִּיצֶר (ב:ז) and יֵצֶר מַחְשְׁבֹת לִבּוֹ (ו:ה; ח:כא) [cognate]. Rendered with the related root צ־ו־ר II (וַיָּצַר אֹתוֹ בַּחֶרֶט, שמות לב:ד; Klein compares it) so that the meaning "draw a design" survives; the apparatus names יצר. 266 (L&M 265)
ṭīdu / ṭiṭṭu טִיט Shared, [cognate]. 199, 207, 209, 222, 227, 230
ruʾtu רֹק 230
kerṣu, karāṣu D קְרִיצָה, קָרַץ [cognate]: מֵחֹמֶר קֹרַצְתִּי (איוב לג:ו). 252
libittu לְבֵנָה [cognate]: נִלְבְּנָה לְבֵנִים (יא:ג). 255, 288, 294
šassūru, pl. šassūrātu אֵלַת־הָרֶחֶם, אֵלוֹת־הָרֶחֶם Lit. "womb"; rēmu "womb" = רֶחֶם [cognate] (I 351). 181–182, 189, 247, 263, 277, 297

aššatu u mussa הָאִשָּׁה וּבַעְלָהּ aššatu = אִשָּׁה [cognate]. 276, 300

Tablet II

Tablet II follows every formula in I.1 above (noise passage, elders/heralds passage, speech formulas, têrtu, nāgiru, šībūtu, ullu, andurāru, guzalû, qurādu, banû). Where Tablet II's Akkadian differs from Tablet I's (other manuscripts, other periods), the Hebrew differs by exactly that much. The words below are Tablet II's own.

II.1 Formulas first found in Tablet II

Akkadian Hebrew Notes Lines (SEAL)
pursā ana nišī tīʾâtam / ana bubūtišina liwīṣū šammū קִטְעוּ לָאֲנָשִׁים אֶת הַמָּזוֹן / לִרְעָבָם יִמְעֲטוּ הָעֲשָׂבִים Past (Assyrian recension): קָטְעוּ … / בִּכְרֵסָם מָעֲטוּ הָעֲשָׂבִים. karšu = כֶּרֶס [cognate]. A 9–10, B 7–8, G 59

qibâ-ma liṣṣurū Anum u Adad elêni … צַוּוּ, וְיִנְצְרוּ אָנוּ וַאֲדַד לְמַעְלָה … naṣāru = נָצַר [cognate]; maṣṣaru = נוֹצֵר. erṣetu qablītu = הָאָרֶץ הַתִּיכוֹנָה; erṣetu šaplītu = הָאָרֶץ הַתַּחְתּוֹנָה. E 71–78, G 16–17, 30–41, 49e–h, 76–77, 84–85

G 18–21, 32–35, 35g, 78–81

Tablet III

Tablet III follows the recurring formulas of I.1 and II.1 (speech formulas; Atram-ḫasīs ilqe têrtam / šībūti upaḫḫir ana bābišu = I 385–386; ubla pīni ištēniš māmītam = II G 29; libbāti mali = II G 13; zīmūšina iʾadrū = II E 155; pursī = II A 9; zabālu Š = I 6). Lines shared with Gilgameš XI copy the Gilg. XI Hebrew wherever the Akkadian is identical and differ exactly where it differs; the full list is in project.md (Tablet III, "Lines shared with Gilgameš XI").

2026-10-21 harmonization (the lead's cross-corpus decisions): šiptu = קֶסֶם (I 249, 250a, 251; was לחש); uqnû = סַפִּיר [equivalent] (III vi 3; was לָזוּרִית). sukkallu / šukkallu = וְזִיר was already the rendering.
